meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

copy.tagline: 将频道连接到代理组并管理隔离级别
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理多个频道与代理组的映射关系
copy.tagline_en: Wire channels to agent groups and manage isolation levels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage mappings between channels and agent groups

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以帮你管理消息频道与智能体组的连接：查看当前配置、添加新频道、调整隔离级别、修改接线，并检查遗留问题。
howto.when: 当你需要设置或重新配置频道与智能体组的关联时触发，例如添加新频道后、初始设置期间，或单独运行以重新配置。

say.text: 帮我查看当前频道和智能体组的接线情况。
把 Slack 工作区 #general 频道接到客服智能体组。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成接线流程，包括隔离选项。

say.text: 检查 WhatsApp 群组是否有遗留的误接线问题。
say.note: Claude 会运行查询并提示修复选项。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you manage connections between messaging channels and agent groups: view current configuration, add new channels, adjust isolation levels, modify wiring, and check for legacy issues.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to set up or reconfigure channel-to-agent-group associations, such as after adding a channel, during initial setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

say_en.text: Show me the current wiring of channels and agent groups.
Wire the Slack workspace #general channel to the support agent group.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through the wiring process, including isolation options.

say_en.text: Check for legacy mis-wired WhatsApp groups.
say_en.note: Claude will run a query and prompt for repair options.
